training.input: full image resized to 392x392, no spatial crop or new augmentation

validation.checkpoint_selection: maximum validation image AUROC; tie-break by pixel AP
validation.image_threshold: maximum F1 on validation scores for the selected checkpoint

test.usage: only after training; primary best-validation checkpoint and reference final-step checkpoint
test.image_threshold: fixed from validation, never tuned using test labels

metrics.image_score: mean of top 1% smoothed anomaly-map pixels
metrics.target: all annotated defects merged as one binary anomaly class

preprocessing_deviation_from_cvpr: Resize the full frame to 392 instead of resize 448 followed by center crop 392, retaining edge defects; model token grid remains 28x28.
publication_gate: Commit and push this plan and code, verify remote HEAD, synchronize clean server checkout, then launch.
